scripts.vercel-build: npm run build && npm run build:pwa && npm run build:admin && npm run build:api-public
scripts.build:admin: npm run typecheck --workspace=@tea-ledger/admin-web && npm run build --workspace=@tea-ledger/admin-web
scripts.build:api-public: mkdir -p apps/api/public && cp -r apps/supervisor-pwa/dist/* apps/api/public/ && mkdir -p apps/api/public/admin && cp -r apps/admin-web/dist/* apps/api/public/admin/
